subject: Level 1 latent variable as dependent variable in regression

messages.author: a914fdf7c59b34a1
messages.subject: Level 1 latent variable as dependent variable in regression
parts:
Dear community, 

I am trying to implement a multilevel SEM. I am laying out the code below. 
All lines of code, except for this one: #diclima + dirins + tais + emotions ~  sesf1 + amotivation + external_s + external_m + introjected + identified + intrinsic ' work well. 

For this line, I get the error: Error: lavaan->lav_lavaan_step02_options():
missing observed variables in dataset: diclima dirins tais emotions

In my understanding, R is not accepting the latent variables created at level 1 as dependent variables in Level 2.
Would highly appreciate support in how this can be fixed. 

Thanks a lot!

Aroob.

#Multilevel SEM:
h2_1 <- '
#Measurement Model:

level: 1

diclima =~ infoclass_notlistening + infoclass_noise + infoclass_longwait
dirins =~ infoclass_review + infoclass_overview + infoclass_checkunderstand
tais =~ infoclass_proactive + infoclass_explanation + infoclass_adaption + infoclass_adjustment + infoclass_indsupport + infoclass_feedback + infoclass_encouragement
emotions =~ assessment_liketeaching + assessment_enjoy + assessment_inspiring + assessment_encouragement + assessment_respect + assessment_understanding
#regression:
diclima + dirins + tais + emotions ~  sesf1


level: 2
#BNSF
need_satisfaction =~ as1 + as2 + as3 + as4 +
rs1 + rs2 + rs3 + rs4 +
cs1 + cs2 + cs3 + cs4
need_frustration =~ rf1 + rf2 + rf3 + rf4 + cf1 + cf2 + cf3 + cf4

#MWMS
amotivation =~ m_1 + m_2 + m_3
external_s =~ m_4 + m_5 + m_6
external_m =~ m_7 + m_8 + m_9
introjected =~  m_12 + m_13
identified =~ m_10 + m_11 + m_14 + m_15 + m_16
intrinsic =~ m_17 + m_18 + m_19

#Regressions
amotivation + external_s + external_m + introjected + identified + intrinsic ~ need_satisfaction + need_frustration '
#diclima + dirins + tais + emotions ~  sesf1 + amotivation + external_s + external_m + introjected + identified + intrinsic '

fit1 <- lavaan::sem(h2_1, data = df, std.lv = TRUE, cluster = "school_id",fixed.x = FALSE)
summary(fit1,fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
lavaan.diagram(fit1)

messages.author: 11d43d7372d66919
messages.subject: Re: Level 1 latent variable as dependent variable in regression
parts:
Dear Aroob,

 

As Yago mentioned, lavaan probably expects variables to be defined at each level at which you want to use them.


For example, if you want to look at motivation from both the within and between perspectives, then you might have to define it at both levels. For example:

level: 1

amotivation_within =~ m_1 + m_2 + m_3

level: 2

amotivation_between =~ m_1 + m_2 + m_3

 

Check out the official lavaan tutorial for a reproducible example:

https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/multilevel.html

 

Best,

Lukasz
